annotation.title_clean: Requirements for the Operation of Unmanned Aircraft Systems (Unmanned Aerial Vehicles/Remotely Piloted Aircraft)
annotation.title_en: Requirements for the Operation of Unmanned Aircraft Systems (Unmanned Aerial Vehicles/Remotely Piloted Aircraft)
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Civil Aviation Authority of Sri Lanka (Director General of Civil Aviation)
annotation.venue: Civil Aviation Authority of Sri Lanka (CAASL Implementing Standard SLCAIS 053)
annotation.summary_en: Sri Lanka's CAASL Implementing Standard SLCAIS 053 (2nd edition, March 2025), issued under the Civil Aviation Act 2010, regulates drones. It sets open, specific and certified operation categories, UAS classes C0–C4 and C25+, registration, remote pilot competency, risk assessment, obligations for importers, manufacturers and sellers, geo-zones, insurance, incident reporting and penalties.
key_provisions_or_claims: Three operation categories (open, specific, certified) with risk-based authorization and operational risk assessment
Registration of UAS and remote pilots, with identification stamp, QR code and public liability insurance for UAS of 250 g or more
Technical class requirements C0–C4 including remote ID, geo-awareness, lost-link behavior and energy limits
Obligations and permits for importers, manufacturers, assemblers and sellers, with conformity assessment and technical documentation
Non-compliance is an offence under Sections 103–104 of the Civil Aviation Act; accidents must be reported within 24 hours
